Name: PUTAWAY
Description:
PUTAWAY

To move stock from a receiving area into designated storage locations, with validation that ensures tracking entities are placed in the correct location based on item code. Prevents mis-shelving by enforcing that the destination location barcode matches the item being put away.

This process is built on the MOVE type with a PreScript (PrescriptPutawayItemLocationValidation) on the Location step that validates the destination location's Barcode starts with the tracking entity's MasterItem.Code. This assumes a naming convention where location barcodes are prefixed with the item code (e.g. location barcode CWF010-1 for item CWF010). If the client uses a different location naming convention, the PreScript must be adjusted — the validation field can be changed from Barcode to Name or another field as needed.
